TEXT: [FI] --you-chan! Kyou-chan, are you listening?

TEXT: [FI] ...Sorry, I was thinking about other things. What were you saying?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Geez, it's about my little brother～

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ahh, is something up with Rock?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Yesterday, when I went to his room in order to pass him a souvenir, he said "I don't know you!" to my face.

TEXT: [FI] Eh? Could he have forgotten?

TEXT: [FI] He said "I'm a rockstar with no family or friends! Both now and in the past, I've been living all by myself!"

TEXT: [FI] ...That fool, he was influenced by something again.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] However, I was frightened for a moment there.

TEXT: [FI] W-Well, isn't it good that it all ended as a joke?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] ...What's wrong, Kyou-chan? You look rather discouraged?

TEXT: [FI] N-No, it's nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Is that so... that's good then.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] However, even if I know it's a joke, it's sad to be 【treated as a stranger】...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Ah, here we are. I'll be heading off myself from here. Kyou-chan, see you tomorrow!

TEXT: [FI] Ah, yeah...

TEXT: [FI] Stranger, huh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Tch, I don't know why, but for some reason I'm irritated.
